data.message: Now you will simulate actual fights. The fight data will be provided yo you as a list of fights of events. Each fight contains two soldier ids and a list of events. Each event contains who attacked who, and how much damage the defender takes from the attacker. You have to simulate each individual fight as a background process. Each event for each fight must be saved into the database. Watch out for the database design. Watch out for concurrency issues while processing fights in parallel. Your last task will be found at /simulate-fight-info. The current list of fight events will be provided starting with the first batch at /fight/0, but you'll have to follow the 'next' param until there are any more batches. Good luck

Now that you have the people registered, soldiers drafted and fight events in place, you will have to simulate the fights. Expose a page in your app at /simulate, and replay each fight. For each fight, launch a background process, then decrease the health points of the defender according to the event of the fight. Fight background processes have to run in parallel. Watch out for concurrency issues. Display the results of fights in HTML on the page mentioned in your app.
